title: K-Pro After Sales — Post-Sales Process Optimization API
subtitle: SaaS Platform & RESTful Lumen API, MySQL Query Tuning (-30% latency) & PHPUnit Testing
summary: Decoupled Laravel Lumen RESTful API as core for post-sales operations, checklists, and equipment lifecycle, achieving 30% performance gain and 80% test coverage.
overview: Development of a high-performance RESTful API in Laravel Lumen functioning as the central digital core (decoupled backend for Vue.js frontend) for K-Pro's post-sales SaaS operations. The platform orchestrates rentals, sales, and shared equipment purchases, handling checklists, documents, status, and history with low latency and high reliability.
roleDescription: Back-End Developer (working in close collaboration with the Solutions Architect).
responsibilities: API Development: Implement RESTful endpoints, business domain rules, and third-party integrations using Laravel Lumen framework.
Performance Optimization: Conduct MySQL query tuning and implement intelligent caching layers to reduce latency.
Quality Assurance: Build a comprehensive test suite with PHPUnit achieving ~80% code coverage to prevent regressions.
Documentation & Team Integration: Author interactive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation to ensure autonomous frontend integration with Vue.js.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Ensure low-latency responses under concurrent load across heavy equipment checklist and lifecycle operations.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Rigorous SQL query tuning, compound indexing, and smart caching layers, achieving a 30% reduction in endpoint response times.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Cover complex multi-stage post-sales workflows and prevent regressions during continuous feature delivery.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Built an automated test suite with PHPUnit reaching ~80% code coverage, safeguarding core business operations.

owaspMitigations.title: Injection
owaspMitigations.description: Strict parameterized queries and ORM query tuning via Eloquent/PDO in Lumen, mitigating SQL Injection risks.
